title: Split restoration run
statement: For every natural number $k$ and Boolean words $w,s$, there is a natural number $t\le 2|s|+|w|+5$ such that the split-restoration machine, run from its scan configuration at position $0$ for $t$ steps, reaches the configuration with state $(4,\text{false})$, input head at position $1$, first work tape storing $s$ with true appended when $|s|\le |w|$ and otherwise storing $s$, all other work tapes blank, all work-tape heads at $0$, and empty output.
